name: halo-computer-browser
description: Computer-use browser research extension for Halo. main/preload/approver are owned by Claude (runtime + approve/execute boundary); renderer/ is owned by Codex (UI). See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-26-computer-use-browser-design.md.

scripts.build: npm run check:runtime && npm --prefix ../../frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.audit.json && tsc -p tsconfig.runtime.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.runtime-harness.json --noEmit
